about: Thai line breaks for text overlays, from Intl.Segmenter (frontend src/components/Reels/lineBreaks.fixtures.test.ts). pieces: the text cut where a line may break (each word with the spaces and punctuation after it). lines: greedy wrap at max_width, measured in characters that take space (not \p{Mn}), trailing spaces not counted; a piece wider than a line breaks between grapheme clusters. The backend checks the same file against PyICU (worker/caption_image.py).
